acquisition_mechanism: scripts/run_repository_native_acquisition_pilot.py (frozen repository list, authenticated evidence, policy-A single-function diff, temporal and source-universe isolation, licence validation) followed by the v2.5 native environment builder and 3/3 official qualification

exclusion_ledger.protected_material: validation shards, reserved confirmation ids and sealed results are NEVER opened; disjointness from them is guaranteed at repository level by excluding every repository source of the corpus (BugsInPy, SWE-bench) and every earlier pilot
exclusion_ledger.repository_key: lower-case repository name without owner (forks/renames collide)
exclusion_ledger.rule: a candidate whose repository key is in this set is excluded

lineage_fingerprint: (repository key, fix commit, target-function fingerprint); two candidates sharing any component are one lineage

near_duplicate_gate.fingerprint: sha256 of the canonical AST of the function: identifiers renamed in order of appearance, annotations and docstring removed
near_duplicate_gate.rule: a candidate whose buggy target-function fingerprint equals any training function fingerprint is excluded

selection.atheris_subset: structurally selected after freezing: targets whose probe is eligible under adapter v5; reported separately
structural_only: official targeted test fails 3/3 buggy, passes 3/3 fixed
selection.underpowered_rule: fewer than 80 targets or 10 repositories -> frozen as built and labelled underpowered (addendum 1 section 3)

status: SPECIFICATION ONLY: no panel acquired, no model generation, no fuzzing

usage_ledger.rule: append-only; every read of panel targets, prompts or outcomes is recorded; any use for training, tuning or checkpoint selection invalidates the panel
